description: This file is a plugin module for the typeahead.js library, providing jQuery plugin methods for initializing and controlling typeahead autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the typeahead plugin on selected elements with options and datasets.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the typeahead is enabled.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the typeahead is active.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the suggestion menu is open.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Triggers autocomplete on a given element.

methods.name: moveCursor
methods.description: Moves the cursor within the input.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the input value.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the typeahead instance and reverts DOM changes.
